symptom: ako/mxcli#1560 (mendixlabs/mxcli#1628): `check -p` reported CE1571 for a list widget's OWN click action with no argument — `listview lv (DataSource: database M.Item, Action: call microflow M.ACT_OpenItem)`, the same as datagrid / gallery `OnClick:` — on pages mxbuild builds (10.24.25: 0 CE1571 for all three; TestApp's ConflictedWorkflowDefinitionView dataGrid2_2, ConflictResolution dataGrid2_1, WorkflowDefinition_Overview dataGrid21 are Studio Pro-authored with empty ParameterMappings). Because exec refuses on a check error, a describe → exec of those pages could not run without --no-check
cause: validateFlowArgumentsIn judged every action slot against `enclosing`, the context around the widget. Right for a button, wrong for the widget that establishes the context: a list widget's click fires per row and the row fills the parameter in. Show page had the same fix since #552 (argContextForOwnAction); the CE1571 walk was its twin
file: mdl/executor/validate_datasource_args.go (isRowAction, actionArgErrors gains the row context, walk computes childContext before the action check)
fix: The "Action" slot (where `Action:` and `OnClick:` both land) of a widget with a data source of its own is judged in childContext(enclosing, ds, …); every other slot (a gallery's onSelectionChange) and the data source itself stay on the enclosing context
insight: **A context rule fixed on one path has a twin on the other**: show page's own-action context (#552) and control-bar selection (#122) both existed, and the CE1571 walk and the flow-call builder each needed the same two facts again. When a context fix lands, grep the other rules that walk the same tree (validate_datasource_args.go, cmd_pages_showpage_args.go, validate_widgets.go) for the shape. The gallery measurement needs care: with the default selection and single-click trigger it fails on "The item click action is ambiguous" (MDL-WIDGET36), not CE1571 — read the error before counting it as a positive. Control the fix with what must STAY reported (row of another type, primitive parameter, non-row slot, a loose button) or it is indistinguishable from deleting the rule
